findings.claim: Regional coordinate contrast evidence is supplied for the observed window, but the manifest declares selection_contrasts=false, so signed favorable-versus-comparison contrasts at the observed selection nodes are not available in this probe.
Whole-window endpoint coordinate effects are supplied as a sparse coordinate prior over the observed window [0.0, 0.49]; these are coordinate contrasts, not physical interaction energies.
A separate whole-window velocity-effects table exists; a temporal derivative is not a coordinate gradient and cannot substitute for the endpoint-coordinate contrast evidence.

Terminal lineage survival effects are recorded, but decoded terminal learning labels are declared unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false); survival semantics differ from selection enrichment and from an absolute geometric descriptor.

Teacher/attention landmarks are supplied as 20 observed-node coordinates with assignment RMS quantiles over 28 counts; these are historical observed-node coordinates usable only as coordinate rewards, not trajectory velocity forces.

The information audit summary is supplied as supporting metadata for the observed support and label semantics; recorded affinities are removed under an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity label is available for the observed window.
Joint-contrast and branch-mutation whole-window effect tables are supplied as additional coordinate-contrast evidence; they do not establish neural-module causation.
The study evidence file contains observations only; no current study outcome evaluation data are supplied to the design roles, so no outcome-based claim can be made here.

limitations: Only regional contrast evidence is supplied in this isolated interface probe.
Transformed copies are never production evidence or inputs to compilation.
Selection contrasts are declared unavailable (selection_contrasts=false), so selection enrichment cannot be distinguished from an absolute geometric descriptor with the supplied evidence.
Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable; survival, selection and last-record joint-head labels have different semantics.
No current study outcome data are available to either role; this diagnostic is never used for generation.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and no temperature edit is proposed or evaluated here.
